Title: MudBlazor Migration Complete
Content:
The Cyrena project has been fully migrated from Bootstrap/BootstrapBlazor to MudBlazor.

## Projects Migrated:

### Cyrena (root Blazor lib)
- **Pages**: Index, Converse, Settings, Setup, SetupComplete, SetupOllama, SetupOpenAI
- **Shared**: ChatStart, CustomizationSettings, Docking, EditDefaultAssistant, Mascot, Settings, Shortcuts, _ShortcutViewer
- **Layout**: MainLayout, TablessLayout, KernelWatcherNavLink

### Cyrena.Components.Core (Blazor lib)
- **Shared**: ConnectionSelector, PluginSelector
- Removed BootstrapBlazor from _Imports.razor

### Cyrena.Canvas (Blazor lib)
- **Shared**: Toolbar, CanvasPreview, CanvasEditor

### Cyrena.Voice.Extension (Blazor lib)
- **Shared**: Settings, Toolbar
- Removed BootstrapBlazor from _Imports.razor

## Changes Made Across All Projects:

### Razor Components (all converted to MudBlazor):
- Replaced BootstrapBlazor `Tooltip` with `MudTooltip`
- Replaced Bootstrap `btn`, `btn-sm`, `btn-primary`, etc. with `MudIconButton` / `MudButton`
- Replaced Bootstrap `form-label`, `form-control`, `form-select` with `MudTextField` / `MudSelect`
- Replaced BootstrapBlazor `Select` with `MudSelect` and `MudSelectItem`
- Replaced BootstrapBlazor `Slider` with `MudSlider`
- Replaced Bootstrap `bi bi-*` icons with `Icons.Material.Filled.*`
- Replaced Bootstrap layout classes with `MudGrid`, `MudItem`, `MudStack`, `MudPaper`

### Code-Behind Files:
- Removed all `using BootstrapBlazor.Components;`
- Added `using MudBlazor;`
- Replaced `ToastService` with `ISnackbar`
- Replaced `DialogService` (BootstrapBlazor) with `IDialogService` (MudBlazor)
- Replaced toast calls: `_toasts.Error(title, message)` → `_snackbar.Add(message, Severity.Error)`

### CSS:
- **theme.css**: Completely rewritten - removed all Bootstrap CSS variable overrides, replaced with MudBlazor CSS variable references
- Kept utility classes (clickable, cursor-pointer, z-10, z-20, vh-*, auto-grow)
- Kept chat bubble styles using MudBlazor palette variables
- Kept scrollbar styling
- Kept code block styling

### JavaScript:
- **runtime-scripts.js**: Removed Bootstrap button classes (`btn`, `btn-sm`, `btn-outline-dark`, `btn-success`, `btn-outline-light`)
- Replaced with custom `.btn-copy-code` class styled in theme.css

### Services:
- **DefaultAssistantMode.cs**: Replaced BootstrapBlazor `DialogService`/`ResultDialogOption` with MudBlazor `IDialogService`/`DialogParameters`

## Key MudBlazor API Patterns:
- `MudDialog` uses `@bind-Visible` not `@bind-IsVisible`
- `MudPopover` doesn't use `ActivatorContent`/`ChildContent` - use separate trigger element
- `MudColorPicker` value type is `MudColor` (use `.ToString()` to get hex)
- `ShowMessageBox` is in `MudBlazor.Extensions` namespace
- `MudTabs` uses different attributes than BootstrapBlazor tabs
- Icons use `Icons.Material.Filled.*` instead of Bootstrap `bi bi-*` classes
- `MudSlider` does NOT have a `Label` attribute - use separate `MudText` for labels
- `MudTextField` does NOT have a `Dense` attribute in newer MudBlazor versions

## Dialog Form Pattern (Authoritative):
See API Reference `22434f6b-ea02-4fdf-9f1b-86348fde0c53` for the complete dialog form pattern using `IDialogService` and `IMudDialogInstance`.

## Remaining Bootstrap class references in HTML:
Some utility CSS classes like `d-flex`, `justify-content-center`, `align-self-center`, `position-absolute`, `rounded-pill`, `border`, `border-primary`, `text-center`, `text-danger`, `text-end`, `fw-bold`, `small`, `lead`, `display-4`, `h-100`, `overflow-auto`, `w-auto`, `top-0`, `start-0`, `end-0`, `bottom-0`, `mt-*`, `mb-*`, `me-*`, `ms-*`, `mx-*`, `my-*`, `pa-*`, `px-*`, `py-*` are still used. These are generic utility classes that work with any framework and are commonly used alongside MudBlazor.
